chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about fox skins: may one perform salat in them? He said: I do not like to perform salat in them.

key_terms.الثَّعَالِبِ: foxes; the animal whose skins are being asked about
key_terms.جُلُودِ: skins or hides used as clothing material
key_terms.فِيهَا: in them, meaning in those skins or garments made from them
key_terms.مَا أُحِبُّ: I do not like; an expression of disapproval

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat in fox skins according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on performing salat in garments made from fox skins. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states his dislike of praying in them, indicating a legal discussion concerning permissible materials for prayer attire.
